decisions: Root/cross-review followup: fallback single-download adapter rechecks the action epoch/privacy/active/abort before every enqueue, not merely before the first. The metadata queue retains at most100 waiters (existing saved-list limit) and each waiter expires after12seconds with explicit retry; cancelled waiters are removed immediately. Timed-out waiting work never starts later and does not release one of the two physical in-flight native slots. Existing native per-request timeouts bound active work.

Root requested matching metadata unknown warning: replace the misleading suggestion to choose LIVE search (which may omit the same badge) with '현재 라이브인지 확인하지 못했습니다. 다시 확인해 주세요.' No policy or authentication change.

Cross-review found that same active provider with a different view could retain the detail key during pending explicit play. The action epoch now also changes on Explore/live/downloads/screenshots navigation: pending new actions are invalidated, while existing playingIds/receivers remain unchanged. Deferred tests exercise all three outgoing views with an existing receiver preserved.

Root review clarification: metadata from opening/retrying details never auto-starts playback. A user explicitly pressing play after its30second action verification expires may continue that same play action after exact re-verification, provided the same detail is still visible, its unique token/epoch remains current, privacy/inactive/close have not invalidated it and capacity remains available. This avoids requiring a second click; a delayed open/background/retry response has no such authority.

Do not infer false from absent badges or true from LIVE in title, missing duration or live-search filter. Unknown search rows remain usable to open, but cannot choose a media path until the exact video's official metadata resolves.

Open detail immediately using existing title/thumbnail and a per-detail spinner. Disable new play/download while resolving and expose retry inside that detail on failure/unknown. Preserve foreground/background opening, active detail, scroll, selection and other existing players. The network response must never reopen a closed detail or switch the active detail.

Every selected video action uses a canonical parsed target and requires returned kind=video, exact ID and canonical URL identity match. A nonboolean live state, mismatch or metadata rejection stays unknown. Do not trust a remote title, stale favorite flag or a search boolean as playback/download authority.

Use existing metadata API, which already bounds two native workers, public response sizes and timeouts. Resolve only opened/selected items; no global card/watch fan-out. Multi-open/download preflights are locally queued at concurrency<=2, deduplicated by exact target within that action. User-visible pending state is bounded; no polling loop or extra media stream.

A detail instance has monotonically unique request identity independent of its target. Close/reopen, newer retry, unmount, privacy activation or provider navigation invalidates pending actions. Resolved metadata may update only still-present matching details/results and may never auto-start media. Existing playing receivers retain their established route and are never remounted because metadata refreshes.

Before download, validate all selected videos before submitting the existing batch. Any live or unknown item prevents that batch from being enqueued and gives an actionable message. Privacy/inactive state is rechecked after awaited metadata and immediately before the queue call; already submitted jobs are not silently cancelled.

A definite live result enables original live playback/chat/recording and blocks VOD download; definite VOD enables ordinary playback/download. Any unknown stays retryable. Current native media verification remains the final authority; frontend preflight is not claimed to eliminate a broadcast ending between metadata and native open.

Known current playing items may be reused by viewing controls without reclassification. New/nonplaying video inputs must be resolved or rejected as unknown. Channel browse lacking authoritative live evidence must not claim the channel is offline; no automatic watch-page fan-out is introduced to scheduler discovery.
Search cards update isLive only after the user-triggered exact metadata resolution. Immediate LIVE badges for unopened ambiguous cards are not claimed. Cumulative 조회수 labels stay unchanged.
